snippet.title: SlashZero - Official Reveal Trailer - Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
SlashZero — a 3D action roguelike platformer. Coming to Steam, Epic, and PlayStation. Wishlist NOW!
Playtest is scheduled very soon. Sign up on Steam for more information. 
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061170/SlashZero/
Follow our social media to learn more. 
X: https://x.com/SlashZeroGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/6spfGrcKpb

As HIEROS-I descends,
the order of time shatters.
Timelines tangle and collide,
allowing him to hide within, weaving chaos and deception.
Timehackers, dive into the Null Void,
Uncover the truth and guard all that you hold dear.

#slashzero #roguelike #action #steam #epic #ps5
